article.title: Still room on the downward side (Italo-Polish fact of the day)
article.excerpt: Consider this: In 2009, Fiat’s five biggest Italian assembly plants produced 650,000 cars using 22,000 workers. That same year, a single Fiat plant in Tychy, Poland, produced 600,000 cars with 6,100 workers.
